summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, but nothing was run. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title after show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal and returning a bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests were added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Per the instructions, I did not run tests, black, or mypy, and did not commit. Formatting and test results are unverified.
